# Check current blue dot status - are they still separate or absorbed?
blue_dots = []
for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'b' and n['pixels'] == 1:
        blue_dots.append(tuple(n['boundary'][0]))
print(f"Blue dots (single pixels): {blue_dots}")

# Check blue cross arms
blue_arms = []
for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'b' and n['pixels'] > 1:
        rows = [b[0] for b in n['boundary']]
        cols = [b[1] for b in n['boundary']]
        blue_arms.append((n['pixels'], (min(rows), max(rows)), (min(cols), max(cols))))
print(f"Blue arms: {blue_arms}")

# Try pressing SPACE to "lock in" the position
action(['SPACE'])
print(f"Score after SPACE: {last_action_result.get('score', 'unknown')}")

# Check white pixel
for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'W':
        print(f"White pixel after SPACE: {n['boundary'][0]}")

</function>
